question: Should imsg adopt `send-sticker` and `send.sticker` as a maintained advanced-bridge contract now that exact-head recipient rendering proof is sufficient?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish current behavior, but only maintainers can accept the durable support commitment for reverse-engineered private IMCore selectors across macOS releases.

options.title: Adopt guarded API
options.body: Merge the single fail-closed surface and maintain its selector compatibility across supported macOS versions.

options.title: Defer stable contract
options.body: Keep the work open or experimental until the same flow is demonstrated on additional supported macOS versions.

options.title: Decline private stickers
options.body: Close the PR and avoid taking on the long-term private-framework support surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded API
recommendation.body: Merge the single fail-closed surface and maintain its selector compatibility across supported macOS versions.
